questions.q: What name did Pharaoh's daughter give the child she drew out of the water?
questions.evidence: She named him Moses, and said, “Because I drew him out of the water

questions.q: How did the angel of Yahweh appear to Moses at Horeb?
options: In a flame of fire in a bush
questions.evidence: Yahweh’s angel appeared to him in a flame of fire out of the middle of a bush

questions.q: When Moses asked God's name, what did God answer?
questions.evidence: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM,” and he said, “You shall tell the children of Israel this: ‘I AM has sent me to you

questions.q: In the first plague, what did the waters of the river become?
questions.evidence: and all the waters that were in the river were turned to blood

questions.q: On the night of the Passover, what would Yahweh see on the houses and pass over?
questions.evidence: The blood shall be to you for a token on the houses where you are: and when I see the blood, I will pass over you, and there shall no plague be on you to destroy you, when I strike the land of Egypt

questions.q: When the sea was divided, what did Israel walk through it on?
questions.evidence: The children of Israel went into the middle of the sea on the dry ground, and the waters were a wall to them on their right hand, and on their left

questions.q: What did the house of Israel call the bread Yahweh gave them?
questions.evidence: The house of Israel called its name Manna, and it was like coriander seed, white

questions.q: At Horeb, what did Moses strike so that water would come out?
questions.evidence: You shall strike the rock, and water will come out of it, that the people may drink

questions.q: Which commandment carries the promise "that your days may be long"?
options: Honor your father and your mother
questions.evidence: Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which Yahweh your God gives you
answerTerms: Honor your father and your mother

questions.q: How long was Moses on the mountain when he went up into the cloud?
questions.evidence: and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights

questions.q: What did Aaron make out of the gold the people gave him?
questions.evidence: He received what they handed him, and fashioned it with an engraving tool, and made it a molten calf

questions.q: What did Yahweh write on the new tablets?
options: The names of the twelve tribes
questions.evidence: He wrote on the tablets the words of the covenant, the ten commandments

questions.q: When the tabernacle was finished, what filled it?
questions.evidence: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and Yahweh’s glory filled the tabernacle
